
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(fBasics)
library(mixtools)
```

Loading in all data to make a collected dataframe
```{r}
collected_df1 <- read.table("collected_5kbpmatrix_rawReadCounts.txt",
                            header = TRUE,
                            sep = "\t",
                            stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

collected_df2 <- read.table("downsampledP10_5kbpmatrix_rawReadCounts.txt",
                            header = TRUE,
                            sep = "\t",
                            stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

collected_df1 <- collected_df1 %>% select(c(-P10_K4me1_rep1, -P10_K4me1_rep2))
collected_df <- merge(collected_df1, collected_df2, by = "Bins")

```

Configuration k2
```{r}
CONFIG <- list(
  seed = 123,
  k_components = 2,
  normalization_percentile = 0.05,
  max_iterations = 100000
)
```

Normalization function
```{r}
normalize_data <- function(data) {
  index <- CONFIG$normalization_percentile * nrow(data)
  
  normalized_data <- apply(data, 2, function(col) {
    sorted_col <- sort(col, decreasing = TRUE)
    normalization_value <- sorted_col[index]
    col / normalization_value
  })
  
  return(as.data.frame(normalized_data))
}
```


Normalizing data and averaging replicates
```{r}
rownames(collected_df) <- collected_df$Bins
collected_df$Bins <- NULL
collected_df_normalized <- normalize_data(collected_df)

collected_df_averages <- collected_df_normalized %>%
  mutate(
    P10_k4me1 = (P10_k4me1_rep1 + P10_k4me1_rep2) / 2,
    P10_k27me3 = P10_k27me3_rep1_dedup,
    P10_k36me3 = (GO_P10_H3K36me3_rep1 + GO_P10_H3K36me3_rep1) / 2,
    MII_k4me1 = (MII_k4me1_rep1 + MII_k4me1_rep2) / 2,
    MII_k27me3 = (MII_K27me3_rep1 + MII_K27me3_rep2) / 2,
    MII_k36me3 = (FGO_H3K36me3_rep1 + FGO_H3K36me3_rep2) / 2,
    MII_k4me3 = (MII_H3K4me3_rep1 + MII_H3K4me3_rep2) / 2
  )

collected_df_averages <- collected_df_averages %>% select("P10_k4me1", "P10_k27me3", "P10_k36me3","MII_k4me1","MII_k27me3", "MII_k36me3", "MII_k4me3")

#logtransforming the data and returning zeros back into zeros
collected_df_averages <- log(collected_df_averages)
collected_df_averages[collected_df_averages == Inf | collected_df_averages == -Inf] <- 0

```


Mixture model version where the population is divided into 2 subpopulations and the smallest value on population 2 is kept for later classification. Bins with zeros are removed from the analysis and put as population 3
```{r}
perform_mixture_analysis_new_k2 <- function(data) {
  set.seed(CONFIG$seed)
  
  results <- data.frame(
    Histone_mark = character(),
    Skewness = numeric(),
    Low_popmean = numeric(),
    High_popmean = numeric(),
    Min_pop2_value = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  pop_assignments <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(data))
  
  for (i in 1:ncol(data)) {
    columnname <- names(data)[i]
    message("Analyzing: ", columnname)
    
    #leaving out the 0 signal bins
    vec_full <- data[, i]
    zero_idx <- which(vec_full == 0)
    nonzero_idx <- which(vec_full != 0)
    vec <- vec_full[nonzero_idx]
    
    model <- normalmixEM(
      x = vec,
      k = CONFIG$k_components,
      maxit = CONFIG$max_iterations
    )
    
    ord <- order(model$mu)
    names(ord) <- c("1", "2")
    
    posterior <- model$posterior
    max_comp <- apply(posterior, 1, which.max)
    population_nonzero <- names(ord)[match(max_comp, ord)]
    
    population_full <- rep("3", length(vec_full))
    population_full[nonzero_idx] <- population_nonzero
    value_full <- vec_full
    
    min_pop2 <- suppressWarnings(min(vec[population_nonzero == "2"], na.rm = TRUE))
    pop_assignments[[paste0(columnname, "_population")]] <- population_full
    pop_assignments[[paste0(columnname, "_value")]] <- value_full
    
    results <- rbind(
      results,
      data.frame(
        Histone_mark = columnname,
        Skewness = skewness(vec, na.rm = TRUE)[1],
        Low_popmean = model$mu[ord["1"]],
        High_popmean = model$mu[ord["2"]],
        Min_pop2_value = min_pop2,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
  
  return(list(
    summary = results,
    population_calls = pop_assignments
  ))
}
```

Preforming the analysis
```{r}
mixture_results_new_k2 <- perform_mixture_analysis_new_k2(collected_df_averages)

results_k2 <- mixture_results_new_k2$population_calls
```

Here using the cutoff assigned by the mixture model to classify if the different bins are positive for the histone mark or not. OBS use separate script to check if the histograms are 
```{r}
results_final <- results_k2


results_final <- results_final %>%
  mutate(
    p10_k4me1_signal  = if_else(P10_k4me1_value  < mixture_results_new_k2$summary$Min_pop2_value[1] | P10_k4me1_value == 0, 0L, 1L),
    p10_k27me3_signal = if_else(P10_k27me3_value < mixture_results_new_k2$summary$Min_pop2_value[2] | P10_k27me3_value == 0, 0L, 1L),
    p10_k36me3_signal = if_else(P10_k36me3_value < mixture_results_new_k2$summary$Min_pop2_value[3] | P10_k36me3_value == 0, 0L, 1L),
    
    MII_k4me1_signal  = if_else(MII_k4me1_value  < mixture_results_new_k2$summary$Min_pop2_value[4] | MII_k4me1_value == 0, 0L, 1L),
    MII_k27me3_signal = if_else(MII_k27me3_value < mixture_results_new_k2$summary$Min_pop2_value[5] | MII_k27me3_value == 0, 0L, 1L),
    MII_k36me3_signal = if_else(MII_k36me3_value < mixture_results_new_k2$summary$Min_pop2_value[6] | MII_k36me3_value == 0, 0L, 1L),
    MII_k4me3_signal  = if_else(MII_k4me3_value  < mixture_results_new_k2$summary$Min_pop2_value[7] | MII_k4me3_value == 0, 0L, 1L)
  )
```

Saving the final file
```{r}
write.table(results_final, "output_files/results_final.txt", row.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE, sep= '\t') 
```
